module.name: RTT-Checkers
module.summary: Triadic interpretation of checkers: tempo, structure, ladders, and collapse risk.
module.purpose: Provide triadic identity for checkers positions using resonance fields, continuity arcs, ladder ancestry, drift, collapse signatures, and Harmonia synthesis.
module.audience: AI researchers, game theorists, engine integrators, diagnostics systems

input_spec.board: 8x8 dark-square occupancy with piece type and owner

steps: Lumen: extract structural signals (piece balance, ladder topology, king presence, tempo anchors)
Hephaestus: classify regime per move (local material/tempo, structural ladders, continuity of plan)
Aurion: compute ancestry (ladder lineage, king walks, collapse signatures, projection-loss)
Harmonia: synthesize triadic identity for the position (local, structural, continuity, risk)
StateEmitter: emit JSON conforming to module_checkers_schema.json

triadic_overlays.resonance_fields: pressure gradients from tempo and structural ladders
triadic_overlays.topology_graphs: ladder topology, king routes, capture nets
triadic_overlays.ancestry_lines: lineage of ladders and king walks

context.drift: Checkers drift is tempo-driven: ladders → king routes → collapse.
context.coherence: Checkers is the RTT module for discrete ladder identity.
